title: Interim Measures for the Administration of Generative AI Services (Regulations.AI)
notes: Regulations.AI (secondary aggregator, NOT issuing authority) — structured English summary of the CAC Interim Measures (2023-7), entry RAI-CN-NA-IMAGAXX-2023, In Force, effective 2023-08-15. Promulgated 2023-07-10 by CAC + 6 ministries. 8 focus areas: data legality, PIPL, content safety, labeling, risk mitigation, transparency/user rights, registration/oversight, accountability. Penalties per Cybersecurity/Data Security/PIPL. TRACES TO primary = source 88 (gov.cn CAC full text).
